name: Parallax

notes: Release metadata consumed by tools\Package-Parallax.ps1. Variables files are enumerated by Stage-Parallax.ps1 and are never listed here. minimumRainmeter is the documented suite target; minimumWindows 10.0 covers Windows 10 and 11, which both report major version 10. author is the credit shown by Rainmeter's Skin Installer. Each plugins entry needs 32bit\<name>.dll and 64bit\<name>.dll under its directory and a license file that ships inside the skin, relative to Skins\Parallax.
